data.one_liner: Implements Material Design feature discovery to highlight app features for new users.
data.what_it_does: It wraps your app and provides overlay widgets that highlight specific UI targets with titles, descriptions, and pulsing animations. It handles sequential feature discovery flows and remembers which features have already been shown to the user using shared preferences.
use_when: You need to onboard new users by walking them through key UI elements step by step.
Your app follows Material Design guidelines and requires feature discovery overlays.
avoid_when: You are building a custom interactive walkthrough that doesn't fit the Material Design feature discovery pattern.
You only need simple tooltips instead of full-screen guided overlays.
strengths: Follows official Material Design guidelines for feature discovery.
Supports sequential step discovery out of the box.
Built-in persistent state handling to avoid showing completed tips repeatedly.
weaknesses: Requires wrapping the widget tree in a global FeatureDiscovery provider.
Customizing complex overlay layouts can be restrictive.
data.setup_notes: Wrap your MaterialApp with the FeatureDiscovery widget.
